title: Paws & Prosecco at Patria
body:

Where: Patria On Main, 228 S Main St, Salinas, CA 93901
What: Paws, prosecco, and Patria. Join us for an afternoon of great food, good people, and four-legged friends. A summer brunch benefiting Peace of Mind Dog Rescue. Dog-friendly courtyard, live adoptable doggie showcase parade, and local vendors.

title: For the Love of Dogs
body:

Time: 1 - 4 pm
Where: Chaminade Resort & Spa , Santa Cruz
Join us for our For the Love of Dogs fundraiser! We will have wine, beer, hearty hors d'oeuvres and plenty of good company!
During the event, we will be holding a silent auction, live auction, paddle raise, and raffle drawing for 4 nights at the Surf Shack on Oahu. And of course, we will have some of our wonderful adoptable dogs on board!
Get your tickets right here!

title: Free Pet Trust Seminar
body:
Date: Saturday, October 17, 2026
Time: 10a - Noon
Where: Via Zoom
What: Learn how a pet trust can bring you peace of mind and ensure your furry family members are cared for in the event of your death or disability. Attorney Whitney Clark will answer your questions about setting up a pet trust for your special four-legged friends. You'll also learn more about our Perpetual Care Program .
Email to register and receive the Zoom link.

title: The Monica Rua Silver Hearts Fund
body:
We are thrilled to announce the creation of the Monica Rua Silver Hearts Fund, a tribute to the tireless dedication that Monica, our co-founder, has to helping senior dogs. After over 15 years of service on the POMDR Board of Directors, Monica continues to make a difference by fostering super seniors, dogs with severe medical conditions, and those in hospice care.
The Silver Hearts Fund will be used to cover extraordinary medical expenses for POMDR dogs, ensuring they receive the specialized care they need. Join us in honoring the incredible legacy and commitment that Monica has created by donating today.
Support A Senior Dog Today

title: The Tiny Dog with the Huge Heart
body:
The Tiny Dog with the Huge Heart by Stephanie Turcotte Edenholm is intended to inspire compassion and empathy in readers of all ages through the story of the life of a real dog named Bernie, who was adopted from POMDR by our co-founder Monica Rua.
The book is available on Amazon.com or at the POMDR Bauer Center in Pacific Grove, CA. Proceeds benefit POMDR.

title: Wooftrax "Walk for a Dog"
body:
You can now support POMDR and help us save more senior dogs by using the Wooftrax app and selecting POMDR as your animal charity of choice. The app is free and it's easy to log your walk.
The more people actively walking with Wooftrax, the greater the donation to Peace of Mind Dog Rescue! Every walk counts, whether it's around the block or a long hike.
No dog in your life right now? No problem. You can still record your walk with the app's "virtual dog," Cassie!
Learn more about Wooftrax

title: Cards and More by Catherine Sullivan Benefiting POMDR
body:
Artist and POMDR supporter and volunteer, Catherine Sullivan, has created a website showcasing her dog and floral themed artwork and greeting cards.
We have an assortment of Catherine's greeting cards, postcards and canvas totes for sale at the POMDR Bauer Center (615 Forest Ave, Pacific Grove).
You can also purchase Catherine's cards and artwork through her zazzle website .
100% of proceeds from the sale of her merchandise go to POMDR!
